entities.name: Alvah Augustus Clark
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alvah Augustus Clark was an American lawyer and Democratic Party politician who represented New Jersey's 4th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives for two terms in the 45th and 46th congress from 1877 to 1881.
